funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Tiered: Small up to £2,000; Large from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any stage in their career; applicant must be the author or editor of the proposed publication with a publisher confirmed and publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to disseminate research on British art through publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering costs such as image licensing, subventions, fees and translation.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed; one Research Project Grant per organisation per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in British art, visual culture and architectural history, designed primarily to support staff costs toward a research project with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or non-profit; the exhibition on which the publication is based may be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Supports the dissemination of research on British art by helping organisations produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, covering practical publishing costs such as images and production.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events intended for a variety of audiences, covering costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis; items must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Helps protect and preserve significant works of British art by providing organisations funding to undertake original and needed conservation research, covering staff and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support to organisations seeking to make their collections freely available to audiences online via digitisation, covering personnel and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: ERBA Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Members of Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA); non-members may apply with membership pending.
opportunities.summary: Micro-grant for ERBA members to support a specific research trip (transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses), with funds to be used between November 2026 and April 2027.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at any stage of career for grants up to £8,000; grants above £8,000 require postdoctoral level or equivalent research experience. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals to undertake research in British art, supporting research time (including backfill) and/or research travel to view collections or visit archives.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals enrolled to start (place confirmed) or already undertaking a master's level or doctoral level degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals beginning or continuing a master's level or doctoral level degree in British art who may face barriers in undertaking their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for registered students to undertake research trips to examine British works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £32,000 for one year, or split over two years for part-time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in British art, part of the New Narratives scheme to increase diversity of perspectives in the field.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £96,000 awarded as £32,000 a year for three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a doctorate degree at a UK-based university, starting between April 2027 and April 2028; international applicants may apply but amount is fixed at £32,000/year.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a doctorate in British art, visual culture or architectural history, paying for university fees with the remainder for living expenses; part of the New Narratives scheme.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year, or £70,000 for two years (paid at £35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to undertake a major project in the field of British art, part of the New Narratives scheme to reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, plus an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to internationally recognised experts.
opportunities.summary: Three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research on a British-Italian topic relating to cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy.
